required_behavior: Working directory: run the command in the host shell's CURRENT cwd (where the user last cd'd), not the project dir. Do not cd the parent shell before the command; the child interpreter inherits the parent's cwd. Remove now-unneeded project-dir cd/restore logic (keep any cwd restore needed only if something still changes the parent cwd, e.g. if the handoff path itself requires it; explain). The result and journal record the actual cwd used (observed, e.g. via the shell's cwd probe).
Timeouts: default 120 s, max 1800 s (backend constant, bridge schema/description text, skill text if it mentions numbers).
Keep: allowed without a Task (task_id null in the journal); paused refuses only new commands, command=null wait on a running command allowed.
Update tests accordingly (cwd = user's current dir at call time incl. after the user cd's elsewhere; parent cwd unchanged afterwards; timeout defaults/max clamp).
acceptance: red->green tests; run tests/backend/test_flow_terminal.py x3, test_workbench_skills, tests/bridge (node handoff_tools + unittest discover), tests/workflow, tests/terminal (real exit codes; /tmp/cw02-g1-venv/bin/python, PYTHONPATH=src)
rules: No real provider requests; never read credential contents or other processes' environ; temp dirs only under /tmp; kill only PIDs you started; never touch ~/wb-urux-sandbox or user processes; no commits; no graphify update.
result_format: checks table first, status, changed paths + sha256, residue. Korean, <=10 lines.
